text:
Liam CS: quick heads-up for Cheshire AI's dedicated pool (eu-west-1-d). renewal touchpoint in 3 weeks, and I spotted a persistent queue depth increase and a spend jump overnight. want to triage before the renewal call.

metrics-bot: alert: queue_depth{tenant=\"cheshire\",pool=\"eu-west-1-d\"} avg 160 (1h) at 2026-03-19T23:14Z, baseline ~45
metrics-bot: gpu_pool_saturation{pool=\"eu-west-1-d\"} 0.87 peak
metrics-bot: tail_latency_p99{tenant=\"cheshire\"} 3.2s -> 6.7s (last 2h)

Liam CS: short prometheus snippets i ran:
```
# queue depth trend for tenant
avg_over_time(queue_depth{tenant=\"cheshire\"}[1h])
# reserved vs burst GPU hours last 24h
sum(rate(gpu_hours_total{tenant=\"cheshire\"}[24h])) by (type)
```

Liam CS: context: they started a new vector-retrieval job that fans out many long-context inferences. we think retries from rate-limits + hot KV cache churn are worsening the queue. renewal team will ask why spend spiked.

Priya SRE: i've seen the pool logs; a lot of low-priority ad-hoc jobs from \"cheshire-dev\" are sitting in the queue and blocking reserved slots. i'll propose a preemption policy tweak and a short eviction for non-reserved labels. planning to push a change at 23:40 UTC. :wrench:

Priya SRE: orchestration patch i'll apply:
```bash
# demote non-reserved jobs and increase reserved slot weight
redwoodctl pools update eu-west-1-d --scheduler-weights reserved=0.85,spill=0.15
redwoodctl jobs evict --label owner=cheshire-dev --grace=60s
```

Noor Billing: noted the spend delta. preliminary estimate: +38% burst/ephemeral hours yesterday; projected incremental cost ~ $4.1k over expected weekly usage. i'll attach a short cost breakdown for the renewal pack.

Liam CS: for renewal discussion i want two scenarios: a) soft: keep current commit, add burst cap + job quotas, and a 2-week enablement session to tune batching. b) hard: suggest increasing reserved commit by 20% (we'll show cost/latency delta).

Priya SRE: after evictions and weight tweak, saturation dropped to 0.66 and queue depth median ~52 within 25m. tail p99 reduced to 2.1s. still seeing a tail from a single slow model shard. investigating shard placement.

Liam CS: thanks. Noor, can you flag whether the extra ephemeral hours can be credited given this was onboarding activity? we often grant a small one-time credit for eval onboarding.

Noor Billing: i can propose a one-time credit up to 25% of the burst delta for onboarding cases, subject to AM approval. i'll draft the approval request and include the exact meter lines.

rl-bot: rate-limit events: tenant=cheshire, window=60s, spikes from 120 -> 480  (2026-03-19T22:50Z -> 2026-03-20T00:10Z). suggested throttle: token-bucket size 40 for cheshire-dev.

Priya SRE: putting a temp throttle on dev runners now to reduce retry storm. applying token-bucket config for label owner=cheshire-dev TTL 6h.

Liam CS: immediate next steps: 1) Priya continue watch for 6h and confirm metrics stable 2) Noor to produce cost delta and credit proposal (ETA: EOD) 3) Liam to schedule a 45-min renewal prep with Cheshire AM + eng (propose Mon 09:00 GMT).

Noor Billing: ack, will include meter IDs and daily delta.

Priya SRE: will post follow-up metrics in this thread once shard placement fix completes.

Liam CS: thanks team. i'll update the renewal playbook with the two scenarios and link to this thread. will also propose an enablement session focused on batching/kv cache strategies to avoid another spike.

metrics-bot: follow-up: gpu_pool_saturation{pool=\"eu-west-1-d\"} stabilized at 0.61 after 00:05Z; queue_depth avg 48 (30m).

Liam CS: closing the operational triage; keeping the thread open for billing doc and renewal scheduling.
